meta.title: dsh-notta
meta.description: Notes panel for Obsidian vaults: links, embeds, callouts, highlights, tables, math, Mermaid and Bases views; create/rename/delete/drag entries, edit in CodeMirror with autosave, ⌘⇧F vault search, backlinks, and inline ![[x.base]] tables. Deletes go to .trash.
